Felix Lin
felix.lin@example.com | Dallas, TX
Felix Lin has 7 years of experience in backend and distributed systems. Most
recently, Senior Backend Engineer at Slate Software (2024-2026), where they led
migration of core services at Slate Software onto Kafka, improving uptime
during peak load. Before that, Backend Engineer at Sable Software (2019-2024).
Education: M.S. Software Engineering, Rutgers University, 2018; B.S. Software
Engineering, University of Maryland, 2015. Core skills: System design, REST API
design, Node.js, AWS, Kafka, Distributed systems, Go, GraphQL, MySQL,
PostgreSQL.
